description: Source code for the Parser class used for parsing Excel formulas within the PhpSpreadsheet library. It includes methods for tokenizing, parsing, and converting formulas into Reverse Polish Notation (RPN) for Excel spreadsheet processing.

classes.name: Parser
classes.description: A class for parsing Excel formulas and converting them into Reverse Polish Notation (RPN). It provides methods for tokenization, syntax validation, and tree construction for formula evaluation within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

methods.name: convert
methods.description: Converts a token into its corresponding PTG (Parse Tree Generator) bytecode, handling strings, numbers, references, functions, errors, and operators.

methods.name: convertNumber
methods.description: Converts a numeric token into PTG bytecode, choosing between integer and floating-point representations.

methods.name: convertBool
methods.description: Converts a boolean value into the corresponding PTG bytecode.

methods.name: convertString
methods.description: Converts a string token into PTG bytecode with UTF-8 Unicode encoding.

methods.name: convertFunction
methods.description: Converts a function name and argument count into the appropriate PTG function bytecode.

methods.name: convertRange2d
methods.description: Converts a 2D Excel cell range into PTG bytecode depending on class (area, areaV, areaA).

methods.name: convertRange3d
methods.description: Converts a 3D range (sheet reference) into PTG bytecode.

methods.name: convertRef2d
methods.description: Converts a 2D cell reference into PTG bytecode.

methods.name: convertRef3d
methods.description: Converts a 3D cell reference (with sheet name) into PTG bytecode.

methods.name: convertError
methods.description: Converts an Excel error code into PTG bytecode.

methods.name: convertDefinedName
methods.description: Converts a named range/defined name into PTG bytecode, if applicable.

methods.name: getRefIndex
methods.description: Retrieves or adds a reference index for an external sheet in the internal references array.

methods.name: getSheetIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of a sheet given its name or -1 if not found.

methods.name: setExtSheet
methods.description: Registers an external sheet name with its index for referencing.

methods.name: cellToPackedRowcol
methods.description: Converts an Excel cell reference to packed row and column format.

methods.name: rangeToPackedRange
methods.description: Converts a cell range into packed row/column range for PTG.

methods.name: cellToRowcol
methods.description: Converts an Excel cell reference into its numeric row and column indices with relative flags.

methods.name: advance
methods.description: Moves to the next token in the formula string, updating currentToken and lookAhead.

methods.name: match
methods.description: Checks if the current token matches certain criteria (operators, references, functions, etc.) and returns it or an empty string.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Main method to parse a formula string into a parse tree.

methods.name: condition
methods.description: Parses a conditional expression involving comparison operators.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Parses an expression, handling operators, constants, references, functions, and errors.

methods.name: parenthesizedExpression
methods.description: Handles expressions within parentheses.

methods.name: term
methods.description: Parses a term, involving multiplication and division.

methods.name: fact
methods.description: Parses a factor, which can be references, numbers, functions, or parenthesized expressions.

methods.name: func
methods.description: Parses a function call with arguments.

methods.name: createTree
methods.description: Creates a parse tree node with value, left, and right subtrees.

methods.name: toReversePolish
methods.description: Converts a parse tree into a string in Reverse Polish Notation.
